dict.string: Abu Track requires GPS access to capture georeferencing coordinates alongside camera positions outdoors.
Abu Track requires always-on background location tracking to log GPS coordinates while the screen is off or while taking photos inside the default camera app.
Abu Track requires access to your Photo Library to scan, match, and sync photos taken during the tracking session with logged coordinates.
Abu Track requires camera access to activate ARKit Visual-Inertial-LiDAR Odometry for precise local metric positioning indoors.
Abu Track requires access to device motion sensors (gyroscope/accelerometer) to record precise camera attitudes and orientations.
Abu Track requires local network access to stream real-time camera tracking telemetry to your Unreal Engine and virtual production workstation.
